title: Fixed-Ledger versus Moving-Ledger Criterion for the RH Root-Composite Route

objects.E_n: transport from visible ledger to completed ledger

exact_confinement_conditions.fixed_ledger: A_Z <= B_n for all n and tr(B_n) -> 0
exact_confinement_conditions.exhaustive_ledger: A_Z <= E_n^* A_Z_n E_n + T_n, A_Z_n <= B_n, tr(E_n^* B_n E_n + T_n) -> 0

support_only_condition: A_Z_n <= B_n with tr(B_n)->0 but no fixed/exhaustive bridge to completed A_Z
